bad.description: a later ref known to be bad

coarse.description: bisect over merged windows first (profiles need sketches)

column.description: only changes of this column count

contract.description: a contract file: a version is bad when the contract fails

good.description: a registry ref (tag or content id) known to be good

kind.description: only changes of this diff kind count

name.description: the committed name whose versions are searched

project.description: a shape.yml project file; its settings apply as for `--project FILE` (the bridge never looks for one on its own)

source.description: the source of `project` whose thresholds apply (needs project)

verify_all.description: test every version instead of bisecting; report any that flips back

async.description: for a command that can run as a job: return a job id at once and run in the background

include_raw_values.description: return raw values (minimum, maximum, category values, offending values) even for classified columns; off by default

max_inline_bytes.description: a result part larger than this is written to a file and returned as a reference
